main.description: Stores a blob for the requesting user while the AppView hosts their space repos. A blob nothing references within a day is deleted.

input.description: The raw bytes. The content type is sniffed rather than trusted.

blob.description: A reference to the stored blob, for use in a record.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: RepoNotHosted
errors.description: The AppView does not host the caller's repos. Upload to the PDS instead.

errors.name: BlobTooLarge
errors.description: The blob exceeds the size limit.

errors.name: BlobStorageUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView has no blob storage configured, so it cannot hold attachments right now.
